messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in the center of a sandy plaza, turns slightly to the side, raises one hand to the head, then places a hand on the hip before turning back to face forward.","camera":"Static medium-long shot from behind the character at roughly waist height, with a long shadow cast toward the camera.","clothing":"Black sleeveless tank top, light blue wide-leg jeans, and dark boots.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, tightly curled hair in a small rounded updo.","identity":"A slim, light-skinned 3D-rendered character seen from behind, with a narrow waist and visible shoulder blades.","scene":"A sunny outdoor fairground or amusement area with a striped carousel on the left, a red ride structure on the right, metal crowd-control barriers, and a hazy city skyline in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The futuristic indoor plaza was replaced with the sunny outdoor fairground from the reference, including the carousel, red ride, barriers, and hazy skyline. The character remains in a similar rear medium-long framing and performs the same walking/turning/head-touch/hip-hand sequence, with warm sunlight and a long shadow consistent with the new scene.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the reference fairground setting while keeping the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged, preserving camera framing/movement and adapting the person's lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was preserved, since the face is not clearly visible from behind.
unexpected_changes: The character's top appears more solid black in the output, while the source top had a visible patterned texture.
